essence: One should write auṃ and hrīṃ, without the phaṭ-syllable, in the eight petals.
Outside it, one should write a chain of cauṃ-syllables using hrīṃ-syllables.
One should write this same mantra in the pericarp.
One should write the syllables beginning with tārā on the petals as before.
On the petals, one should write syllables enclosed by hrīṃ and ending with oṃ.
